_comment: Source groups. Google News RSS is the backbone (incl. site: queries covering gov domains) and is now the ONLY collector: gov_pages was retired on 2026-09-05 (see _gov_pages_note) after measuring that direct gov scraping returned no usable news at all. trusted_sources is the ANTI-FAKE-NEWS whitelist: Google News items whose publisher is NOT on the list are dropped.

trusted_sources._comment: Anti-fake-news whitelist. Direct rss_feeds are trusted by origin (so was gov_pages, which is retired - see _gov_pages_note). Google News items are KEPT ONLY IF their publisher matches a publisher_alias below. Matching is case-insensitive substring on the publisher name Google attaches to each item. IMPORTANT: only publisher_aliases is enforced in code; the *_domains lists are documentation. Add new outlets to publisher_aliases or they stay blocked.

_rss_note: Whitelist-only: direct RSS kept ONLY for ประชาชาติธุรกิจ (in trusted_sources + working feed). กรุงเทพธุรกิจ/ฐานเศรษฐกิจ/ผู้จัดการ/ISIT ดึงผ่าน google_news.site_queries + ผ่าน trust gate. ไทยรัฐ/มติชน/เดลินิวส์ ฯลฯ ถูกตัดออก (ไม่อยู่ใน whitelist ตามคำสั่งผู้กอง). กรมโรงงาน+ศุลกากร ดึงผ่าน site_queries + outlet_queries เท่านั้น (gov_pages ถูกถอดออกแล้ว ดู _gov_pages_note)
_gov_pages_note: RETIRED 2026-09-05 (Phase 7a). Direct scraping of DFT/TISI/Customs/DIW was measured over ~96 cycles a day and produced ZERO usable news: TISI and DIW return 0 candidate links every single cycle, DFT has been unreachable since its TLS chain broke (SSL UNEXPECTED_EOF even with the certs/ bundle attached), and Customs returns 30 links that are the SITE MENU, not news ('แผนผังเว็บไซต์', 'การนำเข้า-ส่งออกสัตว์เลี้ยง'). All four sites render their news with JavaScript, so a static scrape can never see it. Worse than useless: 5 of those 30 menu links scored as RELEVANT and were being stored as news, and the group cost ~5.5s of every cycle. Coverage is unaffected - google_news.site_queries already carries site:dft.go.th, site:tisi.go.th, site:customs.go.th (เหล็ก + จับกุม), site:diw.go.th (โรงงาน + เหล็ก) and site:industry.go.th, which reach the same announcements through a rendered index. BEFORE RE-ENABLING: find a JSON/API endpoint for the site (a static HTML scrape will fail again the same way); src/sources/gov_sites.py is kept in the tree for exactly that day. The URLs that were in use are preserved in _gov_pages_removed below.
